ACT VII OF 2011
ACT VII OF 2011
TRUSTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the Trusts Act, 1882
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
2nd May, 2011
No.PAP-Legis-2(60)/2011/385, dated 2-5-2011.---The Trusts (Amendment)
Bill 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 30
March 2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 30 April 2011, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient
further to amend the Trusts Act, 1882 (II of 1882) for purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It is enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be cited as the Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
